data.body: Already fixed: a456-c689 (committed in 695892e70f on 2026-05-08) added 'Sync against origin/main before push' to merge-to-main-pr.sh:484-515. The sync now fetches origin/main and merges it into HEAD (when origin/main is not an ancestor) BEFORE the publish step (line 517+) and before PR construction. The _fetch_and_rebase_branch retry at line 524 remains as belt-and-suspenders, and the post-push retry at line 540-548 handles concurrent races. Bug was filed 2026-05-17, after the fix landed. Closing as already-resolved.
